'''[[House Tidebreaker]]''' sails out to know. In the Chart Hall of [[the Wave-Reader]], the same coastline is drawn twelve ways and none is marked correct — and the house's lighthouse faces the wrong way: out over the empty [[the Sleeping Sea|Sleeping Sea]], as if calling home what never comes back.
